messages:
harper: heads-up: uploaded RC6 shrinkwrap + full installer to staging-bucket (sealed bundle + manifest-epoch). targeting a tight canary 2026-06-15 22:00 UTC.
diego: which signer/key did we use this time? last month we had a signer mismatch.
harper: signed with ops/kms/2026-rot2, cosign present. manifest path: s3://redwood-artifacts/private/rc6/manifest-epoch.json.sha256
nora: quick scan: one image still points to `connector:staging-temp`. will repush with `connector:rc6-2026-06` and update manifest.
deploy-bot: [automated] preflight checks: artifacts present, cosign signatures FOUND, manifest epoch mismatch: 1 unresolved tag. status: BLOCKED
diego: nora can you also include a shrinkwrap checksum in the manifest? helps offline installers validate chunk sets.
nora: will do. also adding `shrinkwrap: true` flag in manifest to signal airgap client.
harper: plan: 1) pin images and update shrinkwrap entry 2) run airgap VM smoke (vm-airgap-03) 3) deploy-bot canary 10% routes -> 40% on success 4) monitor install-failure-rate and prompt-eval delta. rollback artifact: sealed v5.9.4 in offline/releases.
deploy-bot: gating metrics added: `install-failure-rate < 0.6%`, `prompt-eval-regression < 1.8%`. will auto-abort and roll back to v5.9.4 if gates fail.
nora: pushed `private/connector:rc6-2026-06`, updated manifest with shrinkwrap checksum sha256:ef12... and new epoch id 20260615-1.
deploy-bot: revalidated manifest and signatures. all checks passed. ready for canary window 2026-06-15T22:00Z.
ops-bot: change window: 2026-06-15 22:00-23:30 UTC. paging channel: #eng-oncall if rollback. oncall: diego primary, harper backup.
diego: quick runbook check: does rollback for offline customers require re-signing the old bundle?
harper: no, sealed v5.9.4 is already signed and archived; we keep the signer key for rollbacks per policy. just `deploy-bot rollback --to v5.9.4 --evict-lb` + `edge-cache-invalidate --pattern=installer-*`.
nora: i also added a small preflight to check CDN chunk presence `curl -I edge://chunk/{id}` for the top 3 chunks; run as part of smoke.
deploy-bot: noted - preflight step `cdn-chunk-check` included.
diego: running a dry-run of the rollback at 21:30 UTC to validate artifact access and the `evict-lb` step. will report back.
harper: legal needs final release-note snippet including third-party license changes before we flip canary. nora please paste small blurb here.
nora: release note draft: "Private/VPC RC6 (v6.0.0-rc6): shrinkwrap enabled to reduce airgap download size; manifest epoching for safer rollbacks; cosign key ops/kms/2026-rot2 used; sealed rollback bundle v5.9.4 retained. Third-party license changes: openssl 1.1.1 -> 3.0, curl minor security updates." posted to ticket RL-2301.
diego: LGTM. ping this thread when your dry-run completes or if deploy-bot flips to BLOCKED. :thumbsup:
